name: @cua/replay
//dependencies: I1, stated as a dependency list: there is no model SDK here and there is no
path to one. @cua/discovery is the package that imports Anthropic's SDK, and
it is absent from this object — so a replay that consulted a model would not
compile, rather than merely being against the rules.
The browser driver is likewise absent: this engine speaks only SurfaceDriver.
@cua/surface-web appears below as a devDependency because the integration
test drives a real browser, and its tsconfig is built explicitly in `test`
because it is not a project reference of this package.
